title: Soot-Stained Cutpurse
text: A lone market thief trails you through lantern smoke, more hungry than brave and far too quick with a strap knife. If you lose, lose up to 1 Salvage.
flavor: In Ashen Reach, poverty learns ambush first.

defeatReward.text: You catch the cutpurse and recover a useful market rumor.

imagePrompt: A single soot-stained market thief in patched leather cutting a salvage strap beneath amber lamps, ruined bazaar background, low danger but tense
